verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list real-time 2D rendering as a core feature, and the Breakout example plus a community report of working with sprites show 2D sprite work is supported. Nothing in the pack covers tilemaps or 2D physics, and nothing shows 2D getting first-class parity with the 3D renderer. Missing for 10: tilemap support, 2D physics, evidence that 2D is first-class rather than secondary, in-depth 2D docs.

support.subject: As a game developer, 2D is a first-class workflow — sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics — not a 3D afterthought
